verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file at developers.figma.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), which indexes Figma's developer platform docs (Plugin API, Widgets, and more). Agent-oriented guidance also exists: MCP server docs on custom rules and on structuring files for agents, plus a machine-readable OpenAPI spec for the REST API in a GitHub repo. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or complete per-page markdown variants, confirmation that llms.txt covers the help center and MCP content beyond the truncated excerpt, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents consume it effectively.
